parts.title: Patterns That Work—and Those That Fail
Running the System in the Real World

chapters.title: What Turns an LLM Call into a Production System
chapters.focus: The model reasons and proposes; the surrounding system owns truth.

chapters.title: From Model Output to Safe Action
chapters.focus: Treat every model output as a proposal; commit only outside the model.

chapters.title: Keep the Agent Framework in Its Lane
chapters.focus: Let the framework run the agent; let the platform run the business.

diagram.title: Replace the framework, keep the truth

chapters.title: Design the Architecture Around the Model
chapters.focus: Every record has one owner; the model proposes, never commits.

chapters.title: Give Knowledge an Owner
chapters.focus: Turn knowledge into owned, enforceable rules — not just retrievable text.

chapters.title: Build Context Without Losing the Plot
chapters.focus: Assemble each prompt as a disposable, authorized projection of distinct stores.

chapters.title: Build a Paved Road for Agent Teams
chapters.focus: Make the safe path easier to reuse than the clever shortcut.

chapters.title: Package Capabilities as Versioned Skills
chapters.focus: Version whole capabilities and let evidence, not approval conversations, move each release.

notes.text: Lifecycle state decides what resolution may return

chapters.title: Turn Skills into a Coherent Domain Platform
chapters.focus: Ship domain Skills as one pinned pack that grants no authority.

chapters.title: Use ReAct Without Creating a Runaway Loop
chapters.focus: Keep the reasoning loop inside; keep limits and stopping outside.

notes.text: Loop only when the next step

chapters.title: Route the Work Without Losing Ownership
chapters.focus: Selecting a specialist is not transferring responsibility or granting authority.

chapters.title: Turn Proposed Plans into Safe, Executable Work
chapters.focus: Compile every plan revision; replan the future without rewriting history.

chapters.title: Use Critique to Improve—Never to Self-Approve
chapters.focus: Let critique improve the draft; let independent evidence decide acceptance.

chapters.title: Put People Where Their Judgment Matters
chapters.focus: Bind every human decision to one immutable proposal, then reauthorize before commit.

chapters.title: Keep Long-Running Work Alive Through Failure
chapters.focus: Keep decisions deterministic and replayable; push model and tool calls into recorded activities.

chapters.title: Choose Patterns That Fit Real Enterprise Work
chapters.focus: Start from the obligation, then choose the smallest pattern that protects it.

chapters.title: Architecture Patterns That Fail in Production
chapters.focus: Trace each symptom to its violated boundary, then replace the boundary, not the symptom.

chapters.title: Coordinate Specialists Without Losing Control
chapters.focus: Make collaboration durable work with one owner, narrow grants, explicit joins.

chapters.title: Crossing System Boundaries: MCP, A2A, and Local Control
chapters.focus: Protocols move messages; local gateways re-establish trust before anything is adopted.

chapters.title: Security Starts Outside the Prompt
chapters.focus: Detection may fail; deterministic enforcement must still fail closed.

chapters.title: Carry Identity, Narrow Authority
chapters.focus: Carry subject and actor; grant the intersection, never the union.

chapters.title: Make External Effects Safe to Retry
chapters.focus: Record each mutation's meaning so a retry cannot silently duplicate or overwrite.

chapters.title: Contain the Damage When a Model Is Manipulated
chapters.focus: Assume the model is manipulated; independent limits keep the failure local.

chapters.title: Follow a Run from Request to Verified Outcome
chapters.focus: Trace the decisions and effects that explain a run, not just latency.

chapters.title: Improve the System Without Handing It Control
chapters.focus: Turn production evidence into governed releases, never self-approved change.

chapters.title: Make Governance Part of How the Platform Runs
chapters.focus: Make governance a predictable, risk-proportional path with named owners.

chapters.title: Release New Behavior Without Breaking Work in Flight
chapters.focus: Release the whole behavior graph and keep every run pinned.

chapters.title: Treat Performance as a Business Decision
chapters.focus: Optimize cost and latency per verified success, not token price.
